title: DJSON v0.1.0 Schema
description: Canonical schema for a self-declared Digital JSON (DJSON) document. DJSON trust fields are assertions supplied by the publisher and do not, by themselves, establish identity, legitimacy, or safety.

$schema.description: Optional identifier for the schema used to author this document.

djson_version.description: The DJSON specification version implemented by this document.

offerings.description: Products or services that the entity currently presents.

last_updated.description: The time at which the publisher last reviewed this document, in ISO 8601 date-time form.

name.description: Publisher-facing name of the organization, person, or brand.

type.description: Entity classification selected by the publisher, such as organization, business, or individual.

description.description: Brief publisher-supplied description of the entity.

url.description: Canonical public URL controlled by or representing the entity.

verified.description: A self-declared assertion that the publisher has completed its stated verification process.

verification_method.description: Optional description of the publisher's verification method.

anti_scam_policy.description: Optional publisher policy for preventing impersonation, fraud, or unauthorized distribution.

policy_urls.description: Optional public URLs where relevant policies are published.

type.description: Publisher-selected category, such as product, service, consultation, or course.

delivery_format.description: Optional delivery formats, for example in_person, digital_download, or shipping.

price.description: Optional advertised price, expressed in the adjacent ISO 4217 currency.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code required when price is supplied.

contact.description: Public channels the publisher makes available for contact.
